rationale: wu_2015_trainable-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=6, wu_n_outer=2, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, epochs=12, batch_size=1, lr=0.0002, weight_decay=0.0, loss_base=mse, lambda_neg=0.7, wu_soft_thresh=0.0015, wu_sigmoid_slope=10.0, wu_sigmoid_offset=1.0, wu_band_scale=1.0, wu_residual_blend=1.0, train_n=600, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-6 (one knob vs iter-1 best). NUMBERS: iter-1 0.3009 (BEST); iter-2 0.2805(bands=8); iter-3 0.0(outer=3); iter-4 0.2950(window=3); iter-5 0.2938(epochs=18, mild overfit). CONCLUSION: structure (6,2,window2,range8) AND epochs(12) are at optimum. FAILURE MODE: hr plateaus ~0.30 at fixed structure/epochs; lr is the single most sensitive knob per the prior TPE (it found the 1.1e-4 corner on the OLD split), but lr is UNTESTED on the new 200-case val split -- the optimal lr can shift with a different val distribution. ONE KNOB: lr 1.1e-4 -> 2e-4 (~1.8x, NO param change, 12 params). HYPOTHESIS: if I raise lr to 2e-4 I expect val hr to move off 0.3009 because a modestly larger step converges the 12 scalars (esp per-band log_band_scale) further within the fixed 12-epoch budget; still far below the lr>=1e-3 band-runaway regime, so safe. If hr rises, lr sweeps up next; if it drops, 1.1e-4 confirmed and I sweep DOWN. Budget: same as iter-1 (~819s).
